title: MediSim: Full-Scale AI-Powered Clinical Simulation & Telemetry Ecosystem
subtitle: Cross-platform emergency training suite with synchronized 60 FPS vital waveforms, WebSockets, Groq API, and custom fine-tuned NLP models
description:
🚑 Executive Overview:
MediSim is an intelligent, multi-tier clinical training ecosystem built as the official University Final Year Project (FYP) to bridge the gap between theoretical medical education and high-stress emergency response. Moving beyond physical mannequins, MediSim combines a live Flask-based Instructor Web Station, a high-performance FastAPI backend, and a native Flutter mobile application into a unified clinical simulation network.

Instructors can remotely orchestrate acute cardiac and respiratory emergencies from the cloud, broadcasting physiological parameter changes across connected student terminals in sub-100ms via WebSockets. The platform integrates a dual-engine AI core: an on-device Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) clinical mentor powered by a fine-tuned Google FLAN-T5 model and Groq Cloud API, alongside a custom T5 sequence-to-sequence quiz generation engine that digests official medical curricula into automated, non-repetitive multiple-choice assessments.

🌟 Key Architectural Highlights:
• Instructor Web Control Station (Live Production Web App): Deployed Flask web dashboard allowing educators to configure active training rooms, trigger emergency scenarios, and manipulate live vitals (Heart Rate, Blood Pressure, SpO2, EtCO2).
• Trainee Mobile Terminal (Flutter): High-refresh-rate cross-platform app rendering continuous 60 FPS physiological waveforms (ECG, pulse oximetry plethysmograms, capnography) using custom vector canvas pipelines.
• Commercial Client Validation: Contracted by iConnecto to design and engineer mobile UI prototypes and vital waveform monitoring components.
• Sub-100ms WebSocket Synchronization & QR Pairing: Centralized asynchronous SessionManager that serializes and broadcasts multi-parameter physiological states to dozens of concurrent terminals with instant camera QR pairing.
• Dual-Tier Clinical AI & Fast Inference: Local textbook RAG via Sentence-Transformers and Meta FAISS, locally fine-tuned FLAN-T5 Base (248M) for hallucination-resistant clinical guidance, and Groq Cloud LPU integration for sub-second responses.
• Automated 3-Tier MCQ Quiz Engine: Dynamic PDF ingestion with sliding windows, fine-tuned T5-small generation, and SHA-256 deduplication.
• Multi-role RBAC & Security: Bcrypt password hashing, signed JWT tokens, and automated email OTP 2-Factor Authentication.

title: Clinical Training Monitor App (Live Telemetry & Instructor Control)
subtitle: High-performance medical monitor with real-time waveform visualization, session pairing, and instructor control dashboard
description:
🩺 Project Overview:
The Training Monitor App serves as the dedicated clinical monitoring and interactive telemetry display of the medical simulation suite. Engineered in Flutter with native vector rendering, it turns mobile and tablet screens into realistic hospital-grade bedside patient monitors (ECG, SpO2, Blood Pressure, and EtCO2).

🌟 Engineering & Commercial Highlights:
• Contracted by iConnecto to design and engineer mobile UI prototypes and vital waveform monitoring components.
• Real-Time Waveform Rendering: Developed custom CustomPainter 60 FPS vector canvas rendering algorithms that plot continuous electrocardiogram sweeps, plethysmographs, and capnography curves without frame drops.
• Web Instructor Station Synchronization: Pairs instantaneously with the live Flask Instructor Web Control Station via 6-digit room IDs or camera QR code scans.
• Scenario Execution & Adaptive Response: Students receive immediate dynamic vital changes as instructors manipulate cardiac arrest, severe hypoxia, or anaphylaxis scenarios.
• Clean Architecture: Modular separation into Presentation, Application (Bloc/Provider), and Telemetry Network layers.
